name: Jitters' Completed Journal
summary: Jitters gives up his completed journal, hoping to clear his name and expose the sinister forces haunting Duskwood. The reclusive man fears Sven Yorgen's vengeance after fleeing the massacre at Sven's farm.

sections.title: A Coward's Confession
sections.body: Jitters fled Sven's farm when it was attacked, leaving his half-finished diary among the ruins. In the completed journal, he recounts how mysterious dark riders slaughtered Sven's family. For weeks, the pages were his only comfort as he hid in Duskwood. Now he gives the finished volume over willingly, hoping the truth will spare him Sven's furious wrath.

sections.title: Unraveling the Darkness
sections.body: The journal leads Sven to share what he has seen: black-cloaked riders speaking with the wizard Morbent Fel at the Forlorn Rowe. Sven sends the manuscript north with travelers to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Bishop Farthing reads Jitters' account to learn about the vile taint in Duskwood, then uses its revelations to help craft a holy weapon that can pierce Fel's dark wards.

faq.q: Why did Jitters give up his journal?
faq.answer: Jitters fled Sven's farm during the attack and left an unfinished journal behind. He gives adventurers the completed version to bring to Sven, hoping the full truth will clear his name and protect him from Sven's anger.

faq.q: What does the journal reveal about Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Jitters' completed journal gives his eyewitness account of the tragedy at Sven Yorgen's farm, filling in what his unfinished diary left out.

faq.q: Who is Morbent Fel and how is he connected to the journal?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a necromancer at the Forlorn Rowe. The journal leads Sven to share that he has seen the black-cloaked riders speaking with Fel.

faq.q: Why is the journal taken to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sven sends the journal to Bishop Farthing at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Farthing reads it to understand Duskwood's taint and help prepare a holy weapon that can pierce Morbent Fel's magical wards.

angles.text: As a priest, bringing the journal to Bishop Farthing at the Cathedral of Light puts you in service to cleanse unholy defilement through holy relics.
As an Alliance member, the journal shows how far Duskwood has fallen into peril while Stormwind's leaders focus elsewhere.
